text: The CENTURY 21 Martinot Immobilier group site is published by the Martinot Immobilier group; its Troyes agency is MARTINOT IMMOBILIER TROYES, a SARL with capital of 204 000 euros registered in Troyes (RCS 552 881 757). The CENTURY 21 brand is franchised; the group's agencies are family-owned companies.
short: Groupe Martinot is a family-owned estate-agency group franchising the CENTURY 21 brand.
